tracker.pitch: Keep the bus on the map with the screen locked: use the free Traccar Client app.
tracker.why: This screen can share the bus location only while it is open. Traccar Client keeps sharing in the background, even with the phone locked. Only positions taken during a trip are kept.
tracker.step1Hint: Free, from the app store. One time per phone.
tracker.step2Hint: Tap Connect, then OK in the app. When it asks for location, choose “Allow all the time”.
tracker.stepBattery: Let it run with the screen locked
tracker.stepBatteryAndroid: One time. Phone Settings → Apps → Traccar Client → Battery → choose “Unrestricted” (or “No restrictions”). On Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo or Realme phones also turn on “Autostart”.
tracker.stepBatteryIos: One time. iPhone Settings → Traccar Client: set Location to “Always” and turn on Background App Refresh. Do not swipe the app away.
tracker.scanHint: Scan from Traccar Client: Settings → scan
tracker.step3Hint: At the start of each trip. Then come back here to mark children.
tracker.canLock: You can lock the phone. The bus stays on the map.
tracker.notSending: The tracking app is not sending. Start it so the bus shows with the screen locked.
tracker.notSendingBattery: If it keeps stopping by itself, open “Set up again” and check the battery step.
tracker.finished: Trip finished. You can stop the tracking app to save battery.
tracker.dialogIntro: The crew phone runs the free Traccar Client app so the bus stays on the map with the screen locked. Crew can also set it up from their trip screen. Positions are kept only while this bus is on a trip.
tracker.dialogStep2: In the app, open Settings and scan this code.
tracker.dialogStepBattery: On the phone, set Traccar Client’s battery use to “Unrestricted” (Android) so the phone does not stop it.
tracker.dialogStep3: Tap Start in the app at the start of each trip.
tracker.newKeyConfirm: Phones set up for this bus will stop sending until they are set up again. Continue?
tracker.newKeyDone: New key made. Set up the crew phone again.
tracker.disconnectConfirm: Stop accepting the tracking app for this bus?
tracker.failed: Could not do that. Please try again.
